subject: Pilot kickoff prep: success criteria, RACI & procurement path
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 07 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot kickoff prep: success criteria, RACI & procurement path

Thanks again for the call this morning, Sam — good conversation and clear signals that a short pilot will help validate the latency/cost targets and integration points. Quick recap and proposed next steps below.

Recap (from our discovery)
- Primary goal: evaluate Redwood inference for in-product recommendations on the product detail page (reduce incorrect recommendations by >25% compared to baseline).
- Success criteria (validation): 1) recommendation precision uplift >= 25% on holdout set; 2) 95th percentile inference latency < 150ms at 1k qps; 3) no PII leakage in request/response logs per Acme policy.
- Scope for pilot: subset of catalog (~40k SKUs), 3 A/B buckets (control + 2 configs), 2-week steady-state evaluation after warmup.
- Integration points: App team to call Redwood hosted endpoint; Infra to validate VPC egress and firewall rules; Security to run a short privacy audit.

Proposed owners (high level)
- Redwood: serving runtime, model variant management, baseline embeddings, trial telemetry and cost reporting.
- Acme App: SDK integration and feature toggles (Laura).
- Acme Infra: network, VPC peering, load testing (Rajiv).
- Acme Security: audit checklist and sign-off (Marta).
- Procurement: PO or SOW lead (Elaine).

Attachments: acme_poc_req_20270607.pdf (your intake doc)

Next steps / ask
1) Can you confirm the internal owners and contact info above? (Laura, Rajiv, Marta, Elaine)
2) If owners are good, propose target pilot kickoff week: 2027-06-21 (two weeks to stand up infra & integration).
3) I'll attach a lightweight RACI snapshot and a Redwood trial template in the next message — please review and flag gaps.

Thanks — I’ll hold a 30-minute kickoff invite once we confirm owners and procurement path.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference

On Mon, Jun 7, 2027 at 09:12 AM Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Quick recap and proposed next steps below.

Thanks — looping in a lightweight RACI and a suggested two-week technical timeline (attached). I kept Redwood deliverables narrow so we can show measurable results quickly. Highlights below and attached: redwood-trial-template.pdf, raci_snapshot.csv.

RACI highlights (proposed)
- Responsible (R): Redwood engineering (integration support), Acme App (implementation of SDK calls).
- Accountable (A): Acme Product Ops (Sam) for success criteria sign-off; Redwood AE (Karthik) for commercial milestones.
- Consulted (C): Acme Security (Marta) for audit items; Redwood SRE for load/testing guidance.
- Informed (I): Procurement (Elaine), Legal if scope expands.

Detailed trial plan (two-week technical window after integration)
- Week 0 (warmup/prep): VPC setup, firewall rules, sample data ingestion (masked).
- Week 1: Integration + smoke tests, ramp to 200 qps, baseline capture.
- Week 2: Steady-state evaluation at target qps, A/B analysis, metrics export.

Redwood responsibilities
- Provide trial endpoint, model variants, telemetry dashboard, token-level cost breakdown.
- Run a short pre-deployment security checklist and share evidence (logs redaction, retention settings).

Acme responsibilities
- App: integrate SDK, feature flag toggles (Laura).
- Infra: open egress, validate peering and load testing (Rajiv).
- Security: review and sign off on checklist (Marta).
- Procurement: issue SOW / milestone schedule (Elaine).

Action items (owners)
- Laura: confirm integration owner + ETA (due 6/11).
- Rajiv: confirm VPC/network constraints and a test window (due 6/14).
- Marta: confirm any data residency concerns and PRFAQ (due 6/14).
- Elaine: send preferred SOW template (due 6/14).
- Karthik / Marissa: send invite for pilot kickoff (once owners confirmed).

Attachments: redwood-trial-template.pdf, raci_snapshot.csv

Marissa Cole
